training.newPublicFeatures: Four relative-seat hasWon flags. Added first-layer columns start at zero.

proposalExperiment.selection: Retained for audit. Expanded BC had the higher paired selection net.

training.preparation: Existing exchange-three and missing-suit policies execute before the public decisions used for training.

deployment.proposal: Single masked categorical proposal including the fixed anchor as no-op. Remaining execution is independent of all other logits.
deployment.ordinaryWinValue: Uses scoreHand and regionalAwardValue with the table rules, active payers and ordinary win context.
deployment.legalReady: Legal ordinary waits remain qualified for draw settlement when all copies are publicly exhausted.
deployment.terminalEstimate: Ordinary maximum ron payout with public hasWon exemptions. Opponent non-readiness probability is conservatively estimated at 0.5.

reference.used: Clipped PPO formula, gamma=1 and per-seat rewards. Rules, runtime, features, search and MLP are project implementations.
